# Vendored Abenix SDK

`abenix_sdk/` is an unmodified copy of `packages/sdk/python/abenix_sdk` from Abenix 2.5.10 (MIT licence, Copyright (c) 2026 Abenix contributors). It is vendored so Groundwork installs with no access to the Abenix repository. Install it from PyPI or the Abenix repo instead if you prefer, the import name is the same.
